assumptions.description: Transfer SHIP-Trend age associations and sex-specific marginal central distributions from northeastern Germany to the target adults without claiming population equivalence. HbA1c assay/race/treatment differences and selection can change transport.

Use reported marginal sex medians as conditional location at age 49.5 and BMI 27. The age reference is the midpoint of the admitted 20-79 range, not an extracted source age mean. Location is only approximately calibrated after covariate mixing.

The permitted sources do not identify a contemporaneous BMI effect given only age and sex. Assume 0.18*tanh((BMI-27)/7.5) percentage points, a smooth saturating association with no sex interaction. Values 0.18, 27 and 7.5 are explicit modeling assumptions, not transplanted Hoorn/DIRECT coefficients.

Assume independent individual residuals scale*(exp(0.4*Z)-1), Z standard normal, with scales 1.20 in men and 1.05 in women. The rounded scales are a source-IQR-informed but unestimated allocation of marginal spread to residual variation after age; lognormal skew and tail behavior are assumptions. The median-zero residual has positive arithmetic mean.
Clip output to 3-20 percent as a broad assumed numerical support. These are not extracted reference limits and are not evidence-calibrated tail or disease cutoffs.

Use 20000 invented covariate-only rows, half of each sex, uniform integer age 20-79, BMI independent normal(27,4.5) clipped to 15-50. The range follows admitted adult eligibility; BMI and all joint distributions, sex balance and simulation size are assumptions, not recovered participant data. This deliberately simplified common scenario approximates SHIP-Trend and is reused only for SHIP-0 sensitivity. The true source joint covariate distribution is unavailable in admitted evidence.
Published quantile conventions are not reported; compare with harness linear-interpolation quantiles as an explicit estimator approximation.
Map source HbA1c percent, age in years and BMI in kg/m^2 to task names. Original per-decade age coefficients and SEs are divided by ten for per-year replay; no outcome conversion is used.
Fixed generator parameters; seeds vary independent individual residuals only. Between-seed variation is not source-study, parameter, model-selection or transport uncertainty.

No diabetes-status or treatment model is identified. Right tail, extreme BMI, subgroup and nonlinear scientific results depend strongly on assumptions; no target association validation is implied. Hoorn fully adjusted and DIRECT prospective estimates are not coefficients in this generator.

location_pct.derivation: Use admitted sex-specific marginal medians as approximate conditional references.

age_slope_per_year.derivation: 0.153/10 and 0.191/10; BMI-adjusted sex-specific source coefficients, no spline term in these strata.

residual_scale_pct.derivation: Rounded residual scales informed by 0.8 percentage-point source IQRs and contribution of source age slopes under the assumed age distribution; not residual SD estimates.

output_bounds_pct.derivation: Explicit broad support assumption, unrelated to quarantined healthy limits.
